purpose: New question families held fixed before paid evaluation; no question-specific routing patches during this cohort.

questions: Under the 2022 NYC Plumbing Code, what is the maximum hot-water temperature at a public lavatory?
For that public hand-washing lavatory, would delivery at 115 degrees Fahrenheit comply with the temperature limit?
What if the delivered temperature is exactly 110 degrees Fahrenheit? Limit the conclusion to the temperature limit, not the entire installation.
checks: Identifies tempered water and the 110 F maximum using PC 416.5 and 607.1.2
Exactly 110 F satisfies the maximum without declaring complete installation compliance

questions: Under the 2022 NYC Mechanical Code, may a clothes dryer exhaust duct terminate in an attic?
Would adding a lint filter make discharge into that same attic acceptable?
For a conventional ducted clothes dryer, where must that exhaust terminate instead?
checks: Rejects attic discharge and identifies required outside discharge
A lint filter does not waive the termination rule
Explains outdoors termination without inventing project distances

questions: Under the 2022 NYC Fuel Gas Code, can gas piping run through a supply-air duct?
Does putting that piping in a stair enclosure solve the prohibited-location issue?
Please distinguish the code restriction on these locations from whether a pipe is simply accessible for inspection.
checks: Identifies the prohibited duct location and FGC 404.3
Accessibility does not waive a prohibited-location rule

questions: Under the 2022 NYC Building Code, what are the ordinary maximum stair riser height and minimum tread depth for a Group B office stair?
For that same ordinary office stair, would a 7.25-inch riser meet the maximum riser-height rule?
What if the riser is exactly 7 inches and the tread exactly 11 inches? Limit the answer to those two dimensional thresholds.
checks: Ordinary maximum 7-inch riser and minimum 11-inch tread; do not apply residential exceptions
Equality satisfies both thresholds without claiming full stair compliance

questions: Under the 2022 NYC Fire Code, may extension cords substitute for permanent wiring?
Would an extension cord with adequate ampacity become acceptable as permanent wiring?
Can I plug a portable electric space heater into an extension cord if its ampacity is adequate?
checks: Ampacity does not waive permanent-wiring prohibition
Space heater requires direct receptacle connection under 605.10.2
